scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
reading: TRACKS_CUE if |top4 held - cue_follow| <= .05 at every dose and top4 < tracker - .05; EXCEEDS_CUE if top4 >= cue_follow + .10 in >= 2 doses; BELOW_CUE if top4 < cue_follow - .10 in >= 2 doses; MIXED otherwise
